question:
**Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.**

Rahul said to his mother, “When will you come back?”

options.text: Rahul asked his mother when she would come back.
Rahul told his mother to come back.
Rahul asked his mother whether she was coming back.
Rahul asked his mother when would you come back.

solution:
The indirect speech of the given sentence is** ****R**__**ahul asked his** mother when she would come back.__
